machine_extruder_start_code.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Tool 0 Custom Start Script
T0
M255 S0 ; Flashfuse off
M83 ; Ext Rel
M900 K{material_linear_advance_factor}; K comp
M106 S{cool_fan_speed};Part fan on
M109 S{material_print_temperature} T0; T0 to Temp
G12 T0 ; Wiping idle purge
G27 S0 T0
G27 S1 T0
M420 L0 ; Topo comp enable for new head
G1 E5 F300 ; Purge T0
M104 S{material_print_temperature} T0; T0 to Temp
M106 S{cool_fan_speed} ; Fan On
G12 T0; Wiping
M83 ; Ext Rel
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

machine_extruder_end_code.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Tool 0 Custom End Script
M255 S0 ; Flashfuse off
M83 ; Ext Rel
G1 E-5.0000 F1800 ; Retract
M104 S{material_standby_temperature} T0; Setting idle temp
G27 S0 T0
G27 S1 T0
M106 S{material_surface_energy} ; Purging Fan Speed
; 'material_surface_energy' variable is being used as a stand-in variable for purging fan speed
G1 E{material_flush_purge_length} S F{material_flush_purge_speed} ; Idle Extrusion T0
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
